author: श्रीराघवेन्द्रस्वामी
commentary: रजसि प्रवृद्धे प्रलयं गत्वा मृत्वा कर्मसङ्गिषु काम्यकर्मिणां कुले जायते । तथा तमसि प्रवृद्धे प्रलीनो मृतः मूढयोनिषु दैत्यानां कुलेषु जायते ॥ १४.१५॥
translation:
Going to dissolution when Rajas prevails, he is born among those attached to action; and is dissolved during the increase of Tamas, he is born among the classes of deluded beings. (15)
V. Attached to action: i.e., to Kamya Karma or acts meant to yield some desires. The classes of, &c.: the races of Daityas. (15).
